text:
sasha: Quick idea — mini holiday plant swap + tiny desk-fort photo contest this Friday? succulents, air plants, or tiny holiday cacti welcome :sparkles:
melissa: omg love this. rules? where/when? :seedling:
ben: i'll bring a stack of tiny pots and labels. can donate a few spare succulents too.
omar: also can we do a 'most extra fort' prize? coffee gift card or fancy hot chocolate on me.
alex: low-stakes rules idea: 1) plants must be healthy, 2) forts must be desk-sized (no dismantling furniture pls), 3) one entry per person, 4) photo + short caption. judges = 3 volunteers.
sasha: plan: swap table + fort staging in the north lounge at 3pm Friday. bring a pot or sleeve to transport. signups below (no pressure).
melissa: i'll be a judge! also can host a tiny plant care cheat-sheet sign people can take.
ben: sign-up snippet:
```
Name | Bringing | Need pot?
-----|---------|--------
ben  | 3x succulents | no
sasha| 1x air plant  | yes
alex | 2x tiny cactus | maybe
```
sasha: @lunch-bot can you drop a reminder in #random Friday 2:30pm? :pray:
lunch-bot: Poll posted — "Holiday Plant Swap: can you make it Friday 3pm?" (Yes / Maybe / No) :calendar:
omar: also, tiny tip: glitter is allowed but keep it minimal — cleanup responsibility of the builder :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
alex: prize idea seconded. also let's do a 'people's choice' reaction voting for 24h after. :trophy:
melissa: excited! bringing twinkle lights and mini garland :star2:
sasha: sweet. if anyone wants to drop plants earlier, leave them on the north lounge table and label with your name. see y'all Friday :party_parrot:
